nodes.description: address public owner; set to msg.sender in Owned constructor and updated in acceptOwnership
address public newOwner; pending owner set by transferOwnership and cleared in acceptOwnership
string public symbol, set to "QR" in QRToken constructor
string public name, set to "Initiative Q Reserve Token" in QRToken constructor
uint8 public decimals, set to 18 in QRToken constructor
uint public _totalSupply, total minted supply assigned in QRToken constructor
mapping(address => uint) balances; token balance ledger read/written by transfer, transferFrom, balanceOf and totalSupply
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed; ERC20 allowance ledger written by approve/approveAndCall and consumed by transferFrom
safeAdd(uint a, uint b) public pure; addition with require(c >= a) overflow guard
safeSub(uint a, uint b) public pure; subtraction with require(b <= a) underflow guard
safeMul(uint a, uint b) public pure; multiplication with require(a == 0 || c / a == b) overflow guard
safeDiv(uint a, uint b) public pure; division with require(b > 0) zero-division guard
Owned() constructor; assigns owner = msg.sender
modifier onlyOwner; require(msg.sender == owner) access control gate
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) public onlyOwner; stages pending owner
acceptOwnership() public; require(msg.sender == newOwner) then transfers ownership
QRToken() constructor; sets metadata, total supply and pre-minted balances
totalSupply() public constant; returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using raw unchecked subtraction
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) public constant; returns balances[tokenOwner]
transfer(address to, uint tokens) public; debits msg.sender, credits to, emits Transfer
approve(address spender, uint tokens) public; writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) public; debits balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], credits to
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) public constant; returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender]
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data) public; approves then performs an external call to spender.receiveApproval
function () public payable { revert(); } payable fallback that unconditionally rejects ETH
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) public onlyOwner; external call to an arbitrary ERC20 contract with owner as recipient
msg.sender caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance debits and allowance keys
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) inside approveAndCall
